n3c33c99dc7.headline: Banks impose restrictions on dollar sales: Will the manat depreciate?
n3c33c99dc7.summary: Banks in Azerbaijan have restricted foreign currency sales to the first half of the day for entrepreneurs and citizens, a new measure not seen before.
n3c33c99dc7.why: Currency restrictions can indicate pressure on the national currency and affect liquidity and foreign exchange markets in Azerbaijan.
n3c33c99dc7.why_moved: The new restrictions reduce dollar availability, potentially weakening the manat and impacting currency markets.
